secrets.description: GitHub App ID for the bot account that owns app repos. Without this, app creation fails and no PRs can be opened.
PEM private key for the GitHub App. Single-line with literal \n escape sequences; the loader un-escapes at startup.
Classic PAT with `repo` scope for the bot user. Powers repo creation, branch pushes, PR creation, and the in-app feedback flow (Issues:write on USERNODE_PLATFORM_REPO).
Platform-wide fallback Claude key. Users can override with their own via BYOK; if neither is set, Mayor-driven flows are unavailable.
Bootstrap admin username. The first row in `users` is created with this name and is_admin=true on first boot.

Bootstrap admin password. Hashed at first boot — rotating only takes effect on a fresh DB or via direct SQL update. `private` keeps a hypothetical future self-app-staging container from receiving the prod admin password (would let any PR reviewer log in as admin to prod). Until self-app staging gets wired, no runtime impact.

Signing key for session JWTs and the iframe-issued tokens child apps verify (see app-conventions.md). Required at boot — config.js refuses to start without it. Rotating invalidates every active session. `private` ensures a self-app-staging container could not mint valid prod JWTs.

Cookie-signing secret for express-session. Required at boot. Rotating invalidates every active session cookie. `private` for parallel reasons to JWT_SECRET — staging must never sign cookies that browsers honor for prod.

Postgres superuser password the platform connects with. Used by docker-compose.yml to seed the postgres container, by db-manager.js to spawn per-app databases, and baked into DATABASE_URL for the platform itself. Rotating means rolling the postgres container too. `private` blocks staging propagation of the prod DB superuser.

Platform's on-chain wallet public key for the Usernode social-vibecoding linking flow (chain-poller + auth wallet-link in routes/auth.js). When unset, wallet-linking is gracefully disabled — the platform still works without it.

Private counterpart to USERNODE_APP_PUBKEY. Pre-staged in deploy.yml so any future platform-originated wallet-send flow can use it without a redeploy — currently no runtime consumer reads it. Always set together with USERNODE_APP_PUBKEY. `private` blocks staging propagation: this key signs real on-chain transactions with real funds.
